_comment: macOS: the MSI controller of crosvm's MBI SPIs (package/DroidVMGicMsi.cpp, from Droid-VM/macOS-DroidVM) on /arm-io/gic-mbi, the interrupt parent of Apple's PCIe bridge AppleVirtualPlatformPCIE on /arm-io/pcie (both nodes made by DarwinBoot from the FDT). The bridge's own personality wants an AppleARMIODevice nub; ArmDTPlatform's arm-io nubs are IOPlatformDevice.
name: DroidVMGicMsi
